# weather-forecast

A small project that predicts tomorrow's temperature from public weather data.

## Data
- Korea Meteorological Administration daily observations, 2015-2024 (public data)

## What it does
- Cleans missing values and builds lag features
- Trains a gradient boosting model and compares it with a linear baseline
